hero.subtext: We are a welcoming community uniting our skills to share knowledge, create projects, and have fun together. Join us to connect with like-minded individuals!

bios.yaser_durubi: Honestly, finding the right people to build projects with was always a massive hassle for me. Wearing two hats as both a designer and developer, I often felt caught between two worlds! Someone would tell me I should handle the social media and the other would say let him make the website and the whole thing would grind to a halt. That’s why my friends and I founded Axonode to create the space we always wished we had for connecting with like-minded people. When I’m not tweaking design software or writing code, you’ll probably find me tinkering with hardware at robotics tournaments. Welcome to Axonode I'm so glad you're here!
bios.bersis_sevimli: Hi there, I'm Bersis! I am a software developer, computer engineer, and an active maintainer and author of several open-source projects. Growing up, all kinds of technology around me would pique my interest, and I spent most of my time researching how things worked. Not much has changed, except now I build them on my own! However, building alone can get overwhelming quickly. That's exactly why we founded Axonode. As our Lead Executive, I promise you will always feel welcome here!
bios.kaan_uygun: Hi everyone, I’m Kaan! As Head of Public Relations at Axonode, my main focus is taking incredibly complex technical concepts and making them simple, intuitive, and clear for anyone to understand. I’ve always believed that great communication isn't about using the biggest buzzwords it’s about making ideas accessible. Thrilled to be here and ready to hit the ground running with the team!

Anyone working on their own project can share their idea and needs through Axonode and reach {b2}, or people from other fields who can contribute to their project. Likewise, users can discover projects that interest them, join teams, develop their skills through {i2}, and build {b3}. Axonode aims to transform networking from simply adding people into a natural process built around {i3}. In this way, we aim to help {b4}, create real opportunities for people to showcase their skills, and build a {b5} that grows through collaboration.

questions.title: Questions
questions.subtitle: We got only a 20 questions for that are fairly easy, the results will be better if you are honest ;)
questions.q1: Does changing people's opinions about a topic or persuading them feel natural to you?
questions.q2: When explaining an idea, do you think more about how people will perceive it rather than just the idea itself?
questions.q3: Does meeting new people and discovering different perspectives give you energy?
questions.q4: Are you interested in analyzing why a product or idea becomes successful and understanding the story behind it?
questions.q5: When solving a problem, do you often think, 'How will people react to this?'
questions.q6: When facing a complex problem, do you try to break it down into smaller parts to solve it?
questions.q7: Does it bother you to use something without understanding how it works?
questions.q8: Does finding a solution that nobody has thought of before excite you?
questions.q9: Do you enjoy focusing on a single topic for a long time and working with details?
questions.q10: Do you trust yourself in noticing errors or missing parts within a system?
questions.q11: Is it important to you that something is not only functional but also visually appealing and creates a certain feeling?
questions.q12: Do you ever think about why objects or environments around you are designed the way they are?
questions.q13: Do you believe visual communication is one of the most powerful ways to express an idea?
questions.q14: Does the idea of making something ordinary more eye-catching or unique excite you?
questions.q15: When creating a design, do you consider the experience and emotions people will have?

faq.subtitle: Everything you might want to know before applying.

items.a1: Yes. Applying and being part of the community is completely free — no fees, no hidden costs.
items.a2: Developers, designers, and anyone who builds or wants to contribute to projects — regardless of experience level.
items.q3: Do I need to have my own project to apply?
items.a3: No. You can join with just your skills and get involved in projects that are looking for contributors.
items.a4: Our team reviews your application and gets back to you about the next steps, usually within a few days.
items.q5: Can I bring my own project?
items.a5: Absolutely. Share your idea on Axonode and find the right people to build it with you.
items.a6: Software, design, business, and creative fields — if it can be built, it belongs here.
